workingHub.title: Internal tools wiki and training hub
workingHub.summary: Central searchable place for training, documentation, and tool discovery across Revit tools, Windows apps, and web-based apps.
focusPoints: Tool catalogue: list each tool and what problem it solves.
Training mode: simulate behavior with dummy data before live usage.
Project safety: identify whether a tool edits views, sheets, parameters, files, or model data.
Shared learning: capture known fixes, helper patterns, and examples for new tools.
Broader scope: include pyRevit tools, package utilities, verification tools, and desktop apps.

sections.content: Purpose, owner, status, Revit version, dependencies, data modified, risk level.
Workflow, screenshots, expected inputs, expected outputs, rollback guidance.
Dummy data, example parameters, sample folders, safe test scenarios.
Folder path, file structure, known limitations, error messages, planned improvements.
Internal setup guide, pyRevit docs, Revit API docs, VS Code setup notes, idea portal.

windowsApps.name: Issue Package Creator
windowsApps.info: Windows desktop app for drawing issue package creation. Organises exports, generates binder PDFs, and drafts Outlook emails.

windowsApps.name: Issue Package Verifier
windowsApps.info: Drawing package QA tool. Validates drawing numbers, revisions, and sheet names across Excel registers and PDFs (including ACC cloud).

windowsApps.name: Auto-PDF
windowsApps.info: Standalone PDF ordering and merging utility. Reorders pages by drawing number via titleblock OCR and exports a merged PDF.

webApps.name: pyRevit Course Library
webApps.info: GitHub Pages site for pyRevit training and course material.

webApps.name: pyRevit Tools Wiki
webApps.info: Current static documentation and simulator site for internal tools.

webApps.name: Issue Package Dashboard
webApps.info: Web dashboard for package QA checks and trend monitoring.

toolIdeas.title: Model Health Snapshot
toolIdeas.description: One-click model health summary for parameter completeness and warnings.

toolIdeas.title: View Naming Rules Assistant
toolIdeas.description: Desktop helper to validate naming patterns before in-model updates.

toolIdeas.title: Spec Link Explorer
toolIdeas.description: Web app to cross-reference project specs with parameter standards.
